create.name: HeatherAsh Amara
create.bio:
HeatherAsh Amara is an American author and teacher whose work grows out of a long apprenticeship in the Toltec tradition with don Miguel Ruiz, the writer of The Four Agreements, with whom she later taught side by side. Alongside that lineage she draws on earth-based spirituality, mindfulness and ceremony, and she is a Sundoor firewalk instructor and trainer, having learned the practice from Peggy Dylan. Her books include the Warrior Goddess Training series, The Warrior Heart Practice, Wild, Willing, and Wise, and The Seven Secrets to Healthy, Happy Relationships, written with don Miguel Ruiz Jr.; together they have been translated into many languages.

Through her company Warrior Goddess she teaches online and in person: short recorded courses on boundaries, self-care and letting go, live online workshops on relationships and difficult conversations, a leadership programme for teachers and healers, firewalk instructor trainings in Teotihuacan and pilgrimages such as a Celtic journey through the Scottish Highlands and Hebrides. Many of these she co-leads with her colleague Sarina Harz-Tolbert. She also holds monthly prayer circles and new moon talks on YouTube. After losing her land to a wildfire she started the Center for Creative Intent and now writes about stewardship and climate on her Substack. Her home is in New Mexico.

books.title: Warrior Goddess Training: Become the Woman You Are Meant to Be
books.author: HeatherAsh Amara
books.description: Her best-known book, first published in 2014: a course for women in setting down old stories and living with clarity, courage and creativity. Each chapter pairs Toltec-rooted teaching with exercises.

books.title: The Warrior Goddess Way
books.author: HeatherAsh Amara
books.description: A follow-up to Warrior Goddess Training that goes further into her teaching on living authentically. Published by Hierophant.

books.title: Awaken Your Inner Fire
books.author: HeatherAsh Amara
books.description: A guide to deep personal change that works on how you see and meet the world, rather than on surface habits. Published by Hierophant.

books.title: Warrior Goddess Wisdom
books.author: HeatherAsh Amara
books.description: A book of short daily inspirations from the Warrior Goddess teachings, meant to be opened whenever support is needed. Published by Hierophant.

books.title: The Seven Secrets to Healthy, Happy Relationships
books.author: don Miguel Ruiz Jr., HeatherAsh Amara
books.description: Co-written with don Miguel Ruiz Jr., this book applies Toltec teaching to relationships, looking at how to love without obligation or control.

books.title: A Little Book on Big Freedom
books.author: HeatherAsh Amara
books.description: A brief book that uses the four classical elements as symbols for parts of the inner life, with practices for each. Published by Hierophant.

books.title: The Warrior Heart Practice
books.author: HeatherAsh Amara
books.description: Sets out her four-step reflective practice for meeting difficult emotions with honesty and care. Published by St. Martin's Essentials.

courses.title: Your Heart, Your Boundaries, Your Holidays
courses.description: A three-hour live workshop on Zoom with HeatherAsh and Sarina Harz-Tolbert built around the Warrior Heart Practice. It looks at old relationship patterns that resurface at family gatherings and how to hold your own boundaries.

courses.title: Sundoor Firewalk Certification Training
courses.description: A five-day residential instructor training in Teotihuacan, Mexico, led by HeatherAsh and Sarina Harz-Tolbert as Sundoor firewalk masters. Participants learn to tend the fire and lead firewalk ceremonies for others.

courses.title: Scottish Highlands and Hebrides Pilgrimage 2027: A Wild Willing Wise Celtic Immersion
courses.description: An eleven-day group pilgrimage to ancient sites in the Scottish Highlands and Hebrides, with ritual and ceremony shaped by her Wild, Willing and Wise teachings. Payment plans are offered.

courses.title: Untangle
courses.description: A recorded workshop on using the Warrior Heart Practice when life feels overwhelming. It offers a way to keep showing up without shutting down or losing yourself.

courses.title: Brave, Beautiful Boundaries
courses.description: A recorded mini-course in three video or audio lessons with a guidebook, on setting kind and clear boundaries with yourself and with others.

courses.title: True Self-Care
courses.description: A three-part recorded mini-course with a guidebook on turning good intentions about caring for yourself into steady practice.

courses.title: Letting Go
courses.description: A three-part recorded mini-course with a guidebook on releasing attachment to past and future and working with life's cycles instead of trying to control them.

free_resources.title: When Conflict Comes Home for the Holidays
free_resources.description: A free 75-minute live online workshop with HeatherAsh and Sarina Harz-Tolbert on handling difficult conversations with people you love, on 17 November 2026. A recording is available for a small fee.

free_resources.title: Warrior Goddess Core Strategy Quiz
free_resources.description: A short free quiz that suggests which habitual strategy you rely on when life gets hard, with notes on working with it.

flags: No Shift mention on own site: listed without the link.

Tier: her Instagram and Facebook counts couldn't be read; her site says her books have sold more than 250,000 copies (the Warrior Goddess series over 400,000), which the owner may weigh as editorial stature.

Two own sites: heatherashamara.com (author site) and warriorgoddess.com (her teaching company, where offerings and the contact page are). Both robots.txt files ask for a 10-second crawl delay, which was kept.
Email heatherash@warriorgoddess.com is on her company's contact page; her author site's contact address is her assistant's (sarina@warriorgoddess.com).

ISBNs from her publisher's pages (hierophantpublishing.com/books/…, ISBN-13 in its Bookshop and Barnes & Noble links, converted to ISBN-10) and, for The Warrior Heart Practice, the us.macmillan.com link on her own site (9781250230584); not confirmed on Open Library (blocked for us, 4 Nov 2026).
Wild, Willing, and Wise (her newest book) has no ISBN on her pages, so it isn't in books.
Many offerings are co-led with Sarina Harz-Tolbert, LCSW; the items are spiritual and relational, not therapy.
The Scotland pilgrimage URL in the events list ends '-2025' but redirects to /scottish-pilgrimage/, which shows the July 2027 dates.
